scope: All 60 Part 1 photographs and all 50 Part 3/4 listening graphics
method: Pillow contact sheets inspected with view_image; original source pages 03-05 and 09/10/13 inspected for every test. Audit covers crop completeness, not OCR text correctness or audio.
replacementCaution: Suggested padded boxes preserve the entire original photo; do not pass these through density-based crop trimming. All boxes were inspected again as proposed replacement sheets.
